answer: Each velvet identity must cross a glacier of independent attestations before earning weight. An attestation locks 30 POA for 15 epochs inside a lagoon of audited bonds; a 10% random sample is rechecked each epoch and proven fakes are slashed. Running N clones binds 30N POA for the full window plus compounding audit exposure, so cost grows linearly in N and rises with time. The lagoon stops one identity from borrowing another bond, so fleets stop paying.
